evidence.quote: IFNγ ELISpot assays were performed on freshly isolated PBMC from all 24 subjects at screening and at 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination, using the Human IFNγ ELISpot (ALP) kit (Mabtech).
Stained cells were immediately acquired using an LSR-II (Becton Dickinson).
Anti-r85A IgG was measured in serum samples collected at week 0, 2, 4 and 24.

To assess the effect of vaccination route on cell trafficking we measured the expression of chemokine receptors by surface staining PBMC for 30 min at 37 °C with CCR4/PERCPCY5.5, CCR6/AF647 (Biolegend), CCR7/PECY7 and CXCR3/PECY5 (BD Bioscience) (clones TG6/CCR4, TG7/CCR6, 3D12 and 1C6/CXCR3 respectively).
